The '''D-03 Repair Droid''' was a model of [[Maintenance droid/Legends|maintenance droid]] that was used by the [[Dread Host]], the armies of the [[Dread Masters]] during the [[Galactic War]]. D-03 Repair Droids supported the [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]] stationed at the [[Dread Fortress]] under the command of the [[Droid/Legends|droid]] [[Corruptor Zero]], and fought to defend the fortress during the [[Dread War]].<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
D-03 Repair Droids appear as enemies in the Operation "The Dread Fortress" in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Rise of the Hutt Cartel]]''.<ref name="TOR" />
